en.name: Marincess Truth Heart
en.effect:
2+ "Marincess" monsters
If this card is Link Summoned using a Link Monster with 0 original ATK: You can Special Summon 1 Link-3 or lower "Marincess" monster from your Extra Deck. You can only use this effect of "Marincess Truth Heart" once per turn. You can banish 1 Link Monster Card from your field or GY; destroy 1 card your opponent controls, also for the rest of this turn, you cannot banish monsters with that same Link Rating to activate this effect of "Marincess Truth Heart".
